claim: With user-managed partition keys, records with the same partition key are delivered to the same shard in order. With service-managed record distribution there are no ordering guarantees, because records are distributed for optimal throughput. Service-managed record distribution is not examinable yet.
question: Does service-managed record distribution keep record order?

qualifiers.scope: per record distribution strategy of a data stream
qualifiers.condition: service-managed record distribution was announced 2026-09-23, after the cutoff, so not examinable yet; user-managed partition keys keep their ordering
